title: Garden-Audit Exclusion Config
description: config/garden-audit-exclusions.yaml — instance-local, skill-owned exclusion list. Permanent entries suppress findings indefinitely; temporary entries auto-expire on their `until` date and surface as reappeared findings.

configured.description: First-run marker. False (or absent) = wizard has not yet run; true = user has completed the wizard at least once. Written by the garden-auditor agent wizard (Wizard Step D). The loader ignores this field — it is metadata for the agent, not a rule.

settings.description: Optional tuning knobs. May be edited manually — the configure wizard preserves this block verbatim on rewrite. Absent keys fall back to their defaults.

stale_moc_days.description: Staleness threshold for the stale_moc check in days (default 90): a MOC unmodified for at least this long is flagged.

advisory_pushback_days.description: Rest window in days (default 30) for an acknowledged advisory (stale_moc, duplicate_stem): after the user ticks Acknowledge and applies, the finding is suppressed via the pushback ledger until the window lapses.

exclusions.description: Ordered list of exclusion rules. A finding is suppressed when ANY rule matches its target and check.

target.description: What to suppress. path = prefix match; note = exact path; tag = membership in the note's tags.

type.description: Match semantics: path prefix, exact note path, or tag membership.

value.description: The path prefix, exact vault-relative path, or tag value to match.

checks.description: Which checks to suppress for the matched target. A list of check names, OR the literal string 'all' to suppress every check.

oneOf.description: Suppress all checks for this target.

mode.description: permanent = never expires; temporary = expires on `until` date.

until.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the exclusion expires. Required for temporary; absent for permanent.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this exclusion exists.

created.description: ISO date when this exclusion was created.
